# Series 7 FT1, Made in India, for India

[Learn More][29]
Previous Next

## We acknowledge and appreciate the Indian Government’s decision to reduce the GST rate on solar PV
## modules from 12% to 5%. We expect this adjustment to be a meaningful step toward further
## improving the affordability of solar energy solutions. We remain committed to ensuring that the
## benefits of this reduction are reflected in our pricing — particularly for DCR modules supplied
## to initiatives such as PM-KUSUM.

[Series 7 FT1][30]

## Notice

It has come to our attention that First Solar, Inc’s name and logo might be used as part of a
suspected fraudulent company set up to solicit investment from individuals in India.

First Solar, Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ stock exchange in the United States and
does not solicit investments or personal information via social media or instant messaging apps.
While this is out of our control, we are considering a range of legal options to address this issue.

यह हमारे ध्यान में आया है कि फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक का नाम और लोगो भारत में व्यक्तियों से निवेश मांगने के लिए स्थापित एक
संदिग्ध धोखाधड़ी कंपनी के हिस्से के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में NASDAQ स्टॉक एक्सचेंज पर एक सार्वजनिक रूप से सूचीबद्ध कंपनी है और सोशल मीडिया
या इंस्टेंट मैसेजिंग ऐप्स के माध्यम से निवेश या व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगती है। हालाँकि यह हमारे नियंत्रण से बाहर है, हम
इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए कई कानूनी विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहे हैं।

## Responsible Solar

First Solar proudly established the guiding principles of Responsible Solar – how it treats its
employees, manages its environmental impact, and operates its business. Together, these pillars
produce a responsible solar technology that reduces risk and maximizes returns with respect for
people and the planet.

[Learn More][31]

## Innovative Technology

Derived from decades of leading-edge research and development, capital investment, trial and error,
and defining moments, First Solar’s Cadmium Telluride (CdTe) thin film technology is a product of
dedication. The company stands alone in the industry with its differentiated semiconductor and
streamlined manufacturing process, which yield unparalleled quality and reliability.

[Learn More][32]

## Made in India, for India

Designed and developed at its research and development (R&D) centers in California and Ohio, First
Solar’s advanced thin film PV modules set industry benchmarks for quality, durability, reliability,
design, and environmental performance. First Solar’s new factory in India is expected to produce a
PV module optimized for the country’s operating environment and needs. First Solar has operated in
the Indian market for over a decade and has already deployed over 2 GW of its modules in the
country.

[Learn More][33]

# Series 7 FT1, Made in India, for India

[Learn More][29]
Previous Next

## We acknowledge and appreciate the Indian Government’s decision to reduce the GST rate on solar PV
## modules from 12% to 5%. We expect this adjustment to be a meaningful step toward further
## improving the affordability of solar energy solutions. We remain committed to ensuring that the
## benefits of this reduction are reflected in our pricing — particularly for DCR modules supplied
## to initiatives such as PM-KUSUM.

[Series 7 FT1][30]

## Notice

It has come to our attention that First Solar, Inc’s name and logo might be used as part of a
suspected fraudulent company set up to solicit investment from individuals in India.

First Solar, Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ stock exchange in the United States and
does not solicit investments or personal information via social media or instant messaging apps.
While this is out of our control, we are considering a range of legal options to address this issue.

यह हमारे ध्यान में आया है कि फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक का नाम और लोगो भारत में व्यक्तियों से निवेश मांगने के लिए स्थापित एक
संदिग्ध धोखाधड़ी कंपनी के हिस्से के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में NASDAQ स्टॉक एक्सचेंज पर एक सार्वजनिक रूप से सूचीबद्ध कंपनी है और सोशल मीडिया
या इंस्टेंट मैसेजिंग ऐप्स के माध्यम से निवेश या व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगती है। हालाँकि यह हमारे नियंत्रण से बाहर है, हम
इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए कई कानूनी विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहे हैं।

## Responsible Solar

First Solar proudly established the guiding principles of Responsible Solar – how it treats its
employees, manages its environmental impact, and operates its business. Together, these pillars
produce a responsible solar technology that reduces risk and maximizes returns with respect for
people and the planet.

[Learn More][31]

## Innovative Technology

Derived from decades of leading-edge research and development, capital investment, trial and error,
and defining moments, First Solar’s Cadmium Telluride (CdTe) thin film technology is a product of
dedication. The company stands alone in the industry with its differentiated semiconductor and
streamlined manufacturing process, which yield unparalleled quality and reliability.

[Learn More][32]

## Made in India, for India

Designed and developed at its research and development (R&D) centers in California and Ohio, First
Solar’s advanced thin film PV modules set industry benchmarks for quality, durability, reliability,
design, and environmental performance. First Solar’s new factory in India is expected to produce a
PV module optimized for the country’s operating environment and needs. First Solar has operated in
the Indian market for over a decade and has already deployed over 2 GW of its modules in the
country.

[Learn More][33]

## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

# Energy for the Future

### RWE invests billions of euros for profitable portfolio expansion

[Find out more][200]

# Statements & Positions

### Immerse yourself in exciting perspectives and approaches from RWE on key topics in the energy
### industry

[Find out more][201]

# Events & Financial Publications

### All events and publications for investors and interested parties

[Find out more][202]

# From here, you can kick-start your career.

### Apply now for an exciting job at RWE!

[To the Jobs][203]

## Spotlight @ RWE.com

Wednesday, April 1, 2026

#### Did you hear? Solar powers our lives

... for your coffee, your classrooms, your work. Solar powers the equivalent of half of all European
homes. Together with energy storage, solar power is lowering energy bills, while supporting
communities, farmers and the local as well as national economy.

[ More information ][204]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### What happens to dismantled wind turbines and decommissioned power stations?

The circular economy is an essential aspect of planning modern energy facilities. Recycling and
re-use concepts ensure that valuable resources are preserved, and raw materials are fed back into
the production cycle.

[ Read more ][205]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### Why Resilience Is the Decade’s Defining Challenge

Markus Krebber highlights the urgency of a robust energy system.

[ To the statement ][206]
Wednesday, January 7, 2026

#### Powering the Future

Rising demand, strategic investments, and the path to growth in 2026. Markus Krebber outlines the
main trends shaping the energy sector in 2026 – from surging demand driven by electrification and AI
to the urgent need for stable investment frameworks and a strategy for sustainable, affordable
energy.

[ Read more ][207]
Thursday, November 13, 2025

#### Only five DAX companies on track for Paris climate targets

The latest “whatif?” report by right° confirms that RWE is among the few DAX companies with climate
strategies aligned with the Paris Agreement. This recognition encourages to continue its path to
climate neutrality by 2040. Earlier this year, RWE’s strategy was certified by the Science Based
Targets initiative.

[ More on climate protection ][208]

## "The best energy company we can be!"

With more than 125 years of successful history behind us, RWE has undergone fundamental change and
is now a leading supplier of renewables worldwide. With wind farms, solar power and battery storage
facilities in many countries. Even today, most of our core business is green electricity.

And we want to get better and better, investing billions of euros in renewables and entering the
promising hydrogen technology at full speed. Together, we have achieved a lot and we will continue
on our path: For a sustainable future, for achieving net zero emissions by 2040 - for the best
energy company we can be!

[Our strategy at a glance][209]

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports
HTML5 video

## Our energy for a sustainable life

RWE has reliably supplied people and companies with electricity for more than 125 years – night and
day. Many of us take electricity for granted. As well as the fact that it comes out of our sockets
at any time. And we can, because power generators like RWE make sure that it does. Decarbonisation
and sustainability are key components of our corporate strategy. And we have a clear objective:
climate-neutral by 2040.

[

### Responsibility & sustainability

How we take responsibility and act sustainably

Read more
][210]

### Information for…
* [ Future employees ][211]
* [ Neighbours ][212]
* [ Trading partners ][213]
* [ Investors + analysts ][214]

* [ Press ][216]

[

### RWE @ Social Media

LinkedIn, Instagram & Co.: Follow our accounts for all latest news.

Read more
][217]
[

### Research & Development

Shaping the energy world of the future through innovation.

Read more
][218]
[

### Environmental protection

Environmental protection is an integral part of RWE's sustainability policy.

Read more
][219]
[

### Our locations

An overview of our international locations.

Read more
][220]
[

### Hydrogen

The key to the success of the energy transition.

Read more
][221]
[

### Diversity

We take our responsibility for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion seriously and it's embedded in our
ways of working.

Read more
][222]

## Our expertise – opening up new ways to save electricity

RWE is a trusted partner for electricity generation, building storage systems and energy trading.
Together with our partners we develop innovative solutions and drive technological progress for our
customers. In these times of transition, we all have the unique opportunity to help re-shape the
energy supply for future generations. RWE is changing, its renewables business is expanding
massively and is adapting to meet the new challenges posed within the existing business.

[

### Obtaining energy and trading it globally

Energy knows no boundaries – nor does our enthusiasm for producing it or for operating on trading
markets.

Read more
][223]
[

### Our Energy

Ranging from conventional to renewable energies. Discover all energy sources of RWE.

Read more
][224]
[

### Products and Services

RWE – a strong global partner.

Read more
][225]
[

### Our projects

A selection of our international project highlights.

Read more
][226]

## International, open, diverse – working at RWE

Interested in joining RWE? As an employee you have countless opportunities to become part of our
global #TeamRWE. Regardless of where you come from or your academic background, from here, we are
shaping the future of the energy transition.

Our employees see challenges as opportunities. They are guided by our set of core values: trust,
passion, and performance – in a corporate culture that creates space for creative ideas and
curiosity to explore.

# From here, you can kick-start your career.

### Apply now for an exciting job at RWE!

[To the Jobs][203]

## Spotlight @ RWE.com

Wednesday, April 1, 2026

#### Did you hear? Solar powers our lives

... for your coffee, your classrooms, your work. Solar powers the equivalent of half of all European
homes. Together with energy storage, solar power is lowering energy bills, while supporting
communities, farmers and the local as well as national economy.

[ More information ][204]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### What happens to dismantled wind turbines and decommissioned power stations?

The circular economy is an essential aspect of planning modern energy facilities. Recycling and
re-use concepts ensure that valuable resources are preserved, and raw materials are fed back into
the production cycle.

[ Read more ][205]
Friday, March 6, 2026

#### Why Resilience Is the Decade’s Defining Challenge

Markus Krebber highlights the urgency of a robust energy system.

[ To the statement ][206]
Wednesday, January 7, 2026

#### Powering the Future

Rising demand, strategic investments, and the path to growth in 2026. Markus Krebber outlines the
main trends shaping the energy sector in 2026 – from surging demand driven by electrification and AI
to the urgent need for stable investment frameworks and a strategy for sustainable, affordable
energy.

[ Read more ][207]
Thursday, November 13, 2025

#### Only five DAX companies on track for Paris climate targets

The latest “whatif?” report by right° confirms that RWE is among the few DAX companies with climate
strategies aligned with the Paris Agreement. This recognition encourages to continue its path to
climate neutrality by 2040. Earlier this year, RWE’s strategy was certified by the Science Based
Targets initiative.

[ More on climate protection ][208]

## "The best energy company we can be!"

With more than 125 years of successful history behind us, RWE has undergone fundamental change and
is now a leading supplier of renewables worldwide. With wind farms, solar power and battery storage
facilities in many countries. Even today, most of our core business is green electricity.

And we want to get better and better, investing billions of euros in renewables and entering the
promising hydrogen technology at full speed. Together, we have achieved a lot and we will continue
on our path: For a sustainable future, for achieving net zero emissions by 2040 - for the best
energy company we can be!

[Our strategy at a glance][209]

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports
HTML5 video

## Our energy for a sustainable life

RWE has reliably supplied people and companies with electricity for more than 125 years – night and
day. Many of us take electricity for granted. As well as the fact that it comes out of our sockets
at any time. And we can, because power generators like RWE make sure that it does. Decarbonisation
and sustainability are key components of our corporate strategy. And we have a clear objective:
climate-neutral by 2040.

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

[Learn more][5]

ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

# Sunnova Closure and Support Resources

## A Stronger Future Under New Ownership

Through Sunnova's court-supervised chapter 11 sale process, new owners have acquired substantially
all of Sunnova's assets and operations. Importantly, as part of the sale transaction, SunStrong
Management, an experienced full-service asset manager for the renewables industry, has assumed
responsibility for the servicing of the accounts for in-service customer systems acquired by the new
owner group, Sunnova has ceased independent operations. SunStrong Management has assumed
responsibility for servicing and managing most in-service customer systems—ensuring continuity of
operations, billing, and support for existing customers.

[Read the official announcement from Business Wire][1]

## Who Is SunStrong Management?

SunStrong Management is a full-service asset manager dedicated to the renewable-energy sector. Led
by seasoned industry veterans, SunStrong specializes in the management of existing residential solar
portfolios, including leases, loans, and power-purchase agreements.

SunStrong provides comprehensive services such as operations & maintenance, billing & collections,
and investor engagement, ensuring a stable, customer-first approach for every household they serve.

## What This Means for Sunnova Customers

If your account has transitioned to SunStrong, you should have already received communications
outlining next steps for maintaining your solar service, billing, and account access.

SunStrong's mission is to provide:
* Reliable service for your solar and storage systems
* Transparent, timely communication about your account
* Minimal disruption to your existing billing and performance tracking

Your payment arrangements remain the same. Please continue to make payments as usual until you
receive updated instructions directly from SunStrong.

## Questions About the Transition?

### What happened to Sunnova?

Through a competitive, court-supervised sale process, new owners acquired substantially all of
Sunnova's assets and operations to ensure long-term stability for customers, employees, and
partners.

### Who is managing my account now?

SunStrong Management has assumed customer-facing responsibilities for accounts acquired by the new
owner group, including system monitoring, billing, collections, and customer service.

### Will my payments or contract terms change?

No. You should continue your payments as usual. If any changes occur, SunStrong will notify you
directly with clear instructions.

### I had an in-progress installation. What happens next?

SunStrong is working with GoodLeap, a leading solar-market participant, to facilitate completion of
certain in-progress installations. You'll be contacted by your dealer or a GoodLeap representative
if your project qualifies.

For assistance with in-progress installations, contact GoodLeap at [(888) 975-5436][2] or
[[email protected]][3].

## Additional Resources
* Learn more about Sunnova's Chapter 11 proceedings: [restructuring.ra.kroll.com/Sunnova][4]
* For customer support inquiries, please refer to the contact information provided in your SunStrong
  welcome email.

Last Updated November 2, 2025

SunStrong Management is a full-service asset manager dedicated to the renewable-energy sector. Led
by seasoned industry veterans, SunStrong specializes in the management of existing residential solar
portfolios, including leases, loans, and power-purchase agreements.

SunStrong provides comprehensive services such as operations & maintenance, billing & collections,
and investor engagement, ensuring a stable, customer-first approach for every household they serve.

## What This Means for Sunnova Customers

If your account has transitioned to SunStrong, you should have already received communications
outlining next steps for maintaining your solar service, billing, and account access.

SunStrong's mission is to provide:
* Reliable service for your solar and storage systems
* Transparent, timely communication about your account
* Minimal disruption to your existing billing and performance tracking

Your payment arrangements remain the same. Please continue to make payments as usual until you
receive updated instructions directly from SunStrong.

## Questions About the Transition?

### What happened to Sunnova?

Through a competitive, court-supervised sale process, new owners acquired substantially all of
Sunnova's assets and operations to ensure long-term stability for customers, employees, and
partners.

### Who is managing my account now?

SunStrong Management has assumed customer-facing responsibilities for accounts acquired by the new
owner group, including system monitoring, billing, collections, and customer service.

### Will my payments or contract terms change?

No. You should continue your payments as usual. If any changes occur, SunStrong will notify you
directly with clear instructions.

### I had an in-progress installation. What happens next?

SunStrong is working with GoodLeap, a leading solar-market participant, to facilitate completion of
certain in-progress installations. You'll be contacted by your dealer or a GoodLeap representative
if your project qualifies.

For assistance with in-progress installations, contact GoodLeap at [(888) 975-5436][2] or
[[email protected]][3].

## Additional Resources
* Learn more about Sunnova's Chapter 11 proceedings: [restructuring.ra.kroll.com/Sunnova][4]
* For customer support inquiries, please refer to the contact information provided in your SunStrong
  welcome email.

## Pumps & Valves

### [ **PUMPS & VALVES** ][55]

Alcheme Green Energy Company offers a comprehensive range of high-quality pumps, valves, and motor
solutions for residential, agricultural, commercial, and industrial applications. Our Pumps & Valves
Division delivers reliable fluid handling systems designed for performance, durability, and long
operational life.

We supply borewell submersible pumps, open well pumps, self-priming monoblock pumps, centrifugal
pumps, chemical process pumps, slurry pumps, fire fighting pump sets, pressure booster systems, and
energy-efficient motors. Our product portfolio also includes industrial-grade valves such as
butterfly valves, ball valves, gate valves, globe valves, and check valves to ensure complete flow
control solutions.

With a focus on efficiency, corrosion resistance, and low maintenance, our pumping systems are
suitable for water management, chemical processing, wastewater treatment, agriculture irrigation,
textile industries, power plants, and infrastructure projects.

Alcheme Green Energy ensures trusted brands, technical guidance, and dependable after-sales support
— delivering total pumping and fluid control solutions under one roof.

### [ **BATTERIES & ENERGY STORAGE** ][56]

Alcheme Green Energy Company offers high-capacity, expandable, and safe energy Battery storage
systems with Lead Acid and LFP technology and a smart BMS for longevity and efficiency. For over a
decade, we have built trust, quality, and recognition among customers across Tamil Nadu. Whether
it’s powering your car batteries, tractor batteries, inverter systems, or Solar PV systems, Alcheme
Green Energy is the name that rules the hearts of thousands of satisfied customers.
Our lead-acid batteries are high in quality, and shall power your homes, offices and industries with
more backup times, durability and longer lifetime. Our high performing batteries with sturdy built,
latest features and high performance have made us a top choice among our users.

Our LFP batteries offer scalable energy storage, ranging from 1.5kWh to 1000kWh and above, ensuring
long-term solar energy retention. This helps reduce reliance on the grid, maximize self-consumption,
and optimize renewable energy use for homes and businesses. Built with LFP technology, our energy
storage batteries provide high energy density, enhanced safety, and a longer lifespan. Equipped with
an intelligent Battery Management System (BMS), they prevent overcharging, deep discharge, and
thermal issues, ensuring stable performance. With a modular design, our battery systems seamlessly
integrates into residential, commercial and industrial setups, optimizing renewable energy and
reducing grid reliance.

solutions for residential, agricultural, commercial, and industrial applications. Our Pumps & Valves
Division delivers reliable fluid handling systems designed for performance, durability, and long
operational life.

pumps, chemical process pumps, slurry pumps, fire fighting pump sets, pressure booster systems, and
energy-efficient motors. Our product portfolio also includes industrial-grade valves such as
butterfly valves, ball valves, gate valves, globe valves, and check valves to ensure complete flow
control solutions.

## FAQs

### How do I choose the best Amigo Energy electricity plan in my ZIP code?

The best electricity plan for your home depends on how and when you use energy. Amigo Energy makes
it easy to compare options in your ZIP code and choose a plan that fits your lifestyle.

Here’s how to get started:
* Check available plans in your area. Enter your ZIP code on our website to see plans designed for
  your region.
* Compare plan types. Whether you prefer fixed-rate stability or flexible perks like free nights,
  Amigo has options to match your routine.
* Look for added benefits. Enjoy same-day setup, bilingual support, and even discounts through
  programs like [GoodBundle][31] or [Stat Rewards][32]

No matter which plan you choose, you’ll get honest rates, clear terms, and affordable electricity
service from a Texas-based team you can trust.

### What perks or bill credits are included with Amigo Energy plans?

Amigo Energy offers more than just electricity. We offer perks that make your service feel like a
real partnership.

Depending on your plan, you may be eligible for:
* Same-day setup when you enroll before noon.
* Up to $150 in covered early termination fees when switching from another provider.
* $50 bill credit and a rate discount with [Stat Rewards.][33]
* Exclusive membership perks through [Good Bundle,][34] including rate discounts and eco-friendly
  add-ons.
* Bilingual customer support in English and Spanish.
* Flexible plan options that let you switch or move without service interruption.

These benefits are designed to make powering your home simple, transparent, and stress-free, the
Amigo way.

### Can I switch to Amigo Energy from another light company without service interruption?

Yes! When you switch to Amigo Energy, your electricity service will continue without interruption.

Here’s what happens when you make the switch:
* Your advanced meter automatically reports your final usage to your previous provider.
* From your start date, Amigo Energy begins receiving your usage data and billing accordingly.
* You’ll never be billed twice for the same electricity.

You can even get connected the same day if you enroll before noon - just one more way Amigo Energy
keeps things simple and convenient.

### Are renewable or green energy options available with Amigo Energy?

Yes! Amigo Energy offers several renewable energy options so you can support sustainability while
keeping your home powered.

You can choose from eco-friendly plans and add-ons designed to offset your carbon footprint,
including:
* **The 100% Green Nights Free Plan,** which provides free electricity every night from 9 PM to 7 AM
  through renewable energy certificates or attributes, ensuring household usage is offset by
  renewable sources like hydro, wind, or biomass.
* **JustGreen,** which lets you offset up to 100% of your electricity usage for a low monthly cost.

From plans with sustainability baked in to a convenient add-on, Amigo Energy makes it easy to go
green on your terms, with no complicated contracts or hidden fees.

### Capstone Green Energy has become Capstone Energy+!

To Learn More, Check Out Below

[Learn More][40]

## Power. On Your Terms.
## On Site. On Demand. Always On.

Scalable, fuel-flexible energy solutions for operations that require uptime when the grid can’t.
[LEARN MORE ABOUT CAPSTONE'S ENERGY SURPLUS PROGRAM SOLUTION][41]

## Oil, Gas & Other
## Natural Resources

Tough, tested, and reliable: onshore and offshore solutions that perform in the most rugged
conditions and remote locations.
[View Solution][42]

**100% On site. Always On.**

Our C1000S high pressure natural gas generator satisfies 100% of compression plant demand for
complete energy independence, even when grid blackouts hit. [View Case Study ›][43]

## Extreme Efficiency

Harness the power of combined cooling, heating, and power (CCHP) using our thermal capture
technology.
[View Solution][44]

**95% Total efficiency**

Learn how the Capstone C800S system at Costa Group’s facility provides 800kW of reliable power while
operating as a highly efficient CHP and CO2 fertigation solution.  [View Case Study ›][45]

## Reclaim Waste Energy

Generate power from waste gas fuels, hydrogen blends, and renewable natural gas (RNG).
[View Solution][46]

**$45k In electricity sold back to the grid per month**

The C800S Signature Series microturbine at Biokurasix Handa converts agricultural waste into clean
power, heat, and CO₂ for sustainable farming, showcasing a high-efficiency biogas energy model in
Japan.  [LEARN MORE ›][47]

## Mission Critical Power

From emergency backup power to mission-critical operations, our solutions deliver seamless and
dependable power when it matters most.
[View Solution][48]

**100% Combined Heating & Power**

800kW of clean and reliable power for the PSECU data center UPS provides ultra-efficient facility
heating & power. [View Case Study][49]

## Microgrid

Ultra-reliable energy independence even in remote or harsh locations
[View Microgrid][50]

**$250K+ USD in energy cost savings per year**

Our generators produced 1 GW of low-emissions electricity annually and over a Billion BTUs in hot
water for Magens Junction, an affordable housing development in St. Thomas. [VIEW CASE STUDY ›][51]

## EV Charging

Reliable backup power for EV charging, even where the grid can’t reach.
[View EV Charging][52]

**>99% Fast-reliable uptime**

Our trailer-mounted mobile EV charging unit delivers 180 kW of continuous, off-grid power and can be
deployed in as little as 2 weeks. [View Case Study][53]

## Powering What Matters Most

At Capstone, we strive to be the first choice when energy matters. For nearly four decades, our
guiding principle—to make the ***impossible possible***—has fueled our passion to challenge the
status quo in clean energy.

We deliver low-emission, oil-free microturbine systems that run cleaner, last longer, and perform
where others can’t. With unmatched reliability, fuel flexibility, and ultra-low maintenance, we
power what matters most—anywhere in the world.

[Contact Us][54]

## Flexible Solutions for Every Industry

From 65 kW to multi-MW systems, our scalable, ultra-reliable on-site, on-demand solutions power data
centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil & gas operations, and even festivals and events.

Our systems cut costs and emissions by capturing waste heat, run on fuels from natural gas to
biogas, and provide ultra-reliable power anywhere, on-grid or off. Modular deployments can expand as
your needs grow without increasing site footprint.

[Choose the right solution for your mission-critical project][55]

## Our Edge: The Strength of Capstone Technology

Our cooling, heating and energy solutions deliver reliable, high-quality power when and where the
grid can’t. All while reducing costs, lowering emissions, and operating on a wide range of fuels,
from natural gas to renewable biogas and hydrogen blends.

Unlike reciprocating engines, our oil-free systems run quieter, cleaner, and with far less
maintenance. And unlike solar, wind, or other weather-dependent solutions, our power is always
on—on-grid, off-grid, or in hybrid microgrid

where others can’t. With unmatched reliability, fuel flexibility, and ultra-low maintenance, we
power what matters most—anywhere in the world.

[Contact Us][54]

## Flexible Solutions for Every Industry

From 65 kW to multi-MW systems, our scalable, ultra-reliable on-site, on-demand solutions power data
centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil & gas operations, and even festivals and events.

Our systems cut costs and emissions by capturing waste heat, run on fuels from natural gas to
biogas, and provide ultra-reliable power anywhere, on-grid or off. Modular deployments can expand as
your needs grow without increasing site footprint.

[Choose the right solution for your mission-critical project][55]

## Our Edge: The Strength of Capstone Technology

Our cooling, heating and energy solutions deliver reliable, high-quality power when and where the
grid can’t. All while reducing costs, lowering emissions, and operating on a wide range of fuels,
from natural gas to renewable biogas and hydrogen blends.

Unlike reciprocating engines, our oil-free systems run quieter, cleaner, and with far less
maintenance. And unlike solar, wind, or other weather-dependent solutions, our power is always
on—on-grid, off-grid, or in hybrid microgrid applications.

We’ll put renewable energy onto the system on your behalf to displace the polluting energy you use.

#### **Transform the grid**

You’ll support new, clean energy sources like wind and solar farms, low-impact hydro projects, and
green natural gas producers.

[Power-PurchaseAgreements-1]

### **Bring a new renewable energy project to life**

Large energy users can make a new wind or solar farm viable with a power purchase agreement (PPA).
Our PPA solutions can help your business procure renewable electricity, gain energy cost security,
and demonstrate your commitment to sustainability.

[ Power purchase agreements ][49]

### **Power to the people**

We believe that clean energy should be accessible to all. That’s why we fund community-based green
energy projects like solar panels for schools, nonprofits, and Indigenous communities.

[ Community projects ][50]
[Photo of ribbon cutting at the Gunn's Hill wind farm launch supported by Bullfrog Power's
community-based green energy projects grant]

### What our customers have to say about us

step we can all take to help the environment and fight climate change.

Using only habitat-friendly renewable energy is vital to combating climate change so that nature,
wildlife and people can thrive together. Bullfrog Power is an important part of that fight, and
World Wildlife Fund Canada is proud to be bullfrogpowered.

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

# Создаем успешное будущее энергетики

ERSO — многопрофильная интегрированная компания, ориентированная на комплексное оснащение и
реализацию проектов нового строительства, реконструкцию и модернизацию объектов энергетики.

-

напряжением 0,5 кВ - 1150 кВ
][26]

][27]

и автоматики, интеллектуальные системы учета, система связи, автоматизация и

[ ][41]

30.06.2026
[ "ЭРСО" и время возможностей ][47]

19.06.2026
[ Тяговый «ЭРСО» готов к выпуску установочной серии ][48]
Завершаются испытания грузового электровоза «Орлец» с установленным тяговым трансформатором типа
ОНДЦВ-2400 /25-У2 от холдинга "ЭРСО".
10.06.2026
[ Долгая дорога на Оротукан ][49]

08.06.2026
[ Ростехнадзор выдал "ЭРСО" лицензию на изготовление оборудования для атомных станций ][50]
Лицензия подтверждает полное соответствие производственных мощностей, технического оснащения,

## Selected Projects

### Fluid Rotary Union

Optimize fluid flow between a fixed source and rotating systems with advanced technology for
cooling, hydraulic power, and more.

[ Read More ][59]
[ See all projects ][60]
People Are at the Heart
We treat our stakeholders as friends. This entails deep listening and getting to the core of their
technological and commercial needs. This disposition results in long-lasting relationships and
customized, dedicated sealing solutions.
Engineering Prowess
We are the go-to provider of tailored solutions for complex sealing and rotary equipment
requirements. Our long track record at the technological forefront of mechanical sealing, combined
with the knowledge accumulated at the Gevasol Group, helps us address our customers' unique needs
and complex systems.
Flexibility, Adaptability & Innovation
Our technological depth and unflinching approach to challenges allow us to adjust to the
ever-changing playing field. We address the growing and urgent need to protect the environment with
the reliable, durable sealing of contaminating materials.
Quality, Reliability, & Durability
Order, accuracy, and adherence to procedures and quality standards are the cornerstones of our
culture, resulting in products with high performance that remain durable over the years, even under
harsh environmental conditions.

# Discover Trusted *European Providers*

EuropeanSwitch is a discovery platform designed to help organisations explore and identify European
companies across industries. By bringing together providers, sectors and innovation ecosystems into
a structured environment, the platform makes it easier to discover European capabilities and explore
trusted alternatives.

Only European-headquartered companies — organised by sector, independently maintained, and free to
use.

[Explore Sectors →][8] [Why European?][9]
16Sectors covered
PanEuropean provider discovery

Strategic context

## Why Organisations Explore European Providers

Across Europe, thousands of companies offer world-class technologies, services and capabilities.
However, discovering these organisations can be challenging as information is often fragmented
across industry networks, conferences, reports and regional directories.

Key reasons organisations increasingly explore European providers include:

🔗
Supply Chain Resilience
Organisations are increasingly looking to diversify supply chains and reduce reliance on
concentrated global suppliers.
⚖️
Regulatory Alignment
European providers often operate within regulatory frameworks aligned with European data protection,
compliance and governance standards.
💡
Innovation Ecosystems
Europe hosts strong innovation ecosystems across sectors including technology, finance, advanced
industry and infrastructure.
🌍
Strategic Autonomy
European companies are playing an increasingly important role in strengthening regional capabilities
across key industries.

## Ecosystem Participation

### European Companies

Companies are listed within the platform's provider directory. Basic listings are available free of

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# **Who We Are**

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# Connecting what matters.
* [Solar & Energy][1]
* [Welding][2]

[In the center is a man in uniform with a Fronius welding machine, walking along a roof covered with
solar panels.]

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]
About us
How did it all begin? Who are our customers? And how can you apply to join us? Discover our story.
[Learn more about us][5]
Latest news
In our press and news area you’ll find all the latest updates about our products and the company.
[Latest news & press releases][6]

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]
[Fronius Fortis]

## Fronius News

[Fronius employee]

## Fronius as an employer

As a family business, we are characterized by a special spirit—a sense of togetherness that shapes
our corporate culture. Whether in development, production, or our international teams, together we
embody “Connecting what matters” to create solutions that make a real difference today and tomorrow.
We are Fronius.

hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

## Making connections since 1945.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.

### Защо да изберете нас?

Green Energy Supplier е официален дистрибутор на водещи производители на соларни панели, инвертори и
системи за съхранение на енергия, тествани и сертифицирани за работа при тежки условия. за България
и Европа, доставяме висококачествено оборудване на пазара, което гарантира висок добив на слънчева
електроенергия, надеждност и висока ефективност.

Предоставяме консултации, проектиране и доставка на соларно оборудване от най-висок клас. Изготвяме
техническа и финансова обосновка за местни и международни финансови организации, за да подкрепим
вашите проекти.

### Най-новите технологии

Концентрирани сме върху първокласните технологии. Предлагаме най-сигурните иновативни решения в
соларната индустрия.

### С грижа към природата

Слънчевите технологии са бъдещето на планетата. Нашият ангажимент е да осигурим устойчиви и чисти

## [Vacuum Circuit Breaker][73]

GEE is committed to providing high-quality and highly reliable Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB)
products. We insist on **100% in-house production of all machined parts** to ensure product
consistency and manufacturing quality. During production, we implement **lean management
practices**, set up fixed workstations, and adopt a **“one station, one box”** material assembly
system to significantly improve assembly efficiency and process control. Our **core
components—operating mechanisms and wiring harnesses—are manufactured and assembled domestically**,
making them our flagship products and widely recognized in the market. With **rich OEM experience
for leading VCB brands**, our operational model has been adopted by many well-known companies.

******   ****  **

Currently, our annual output exceeds **50,000 AIS operating mechanisms and over 7,000 VCBs**,
ensuring sufficient capacity and stable delivery. The company is certified under **both ISO 9001 and
ISO 14001** management systems. Before leaving the factory, each product undergoes **50 final
operations for mechanisms and 100 operations for VCBs**, along with strict inspections of materials
and finished products using advanced equipment to guarantee quality and reliability. Our warehouse
maintains a **three-month safety stock**, enabling quick response to customer demands. These
comprehensive advantages bring tangible benefits: **efficient component modifications, shorter lead
times, consistent product quality, and highly competitive pricing**. Our VCBs are **compatible with
a wide range of brands**, including Eaton, Baoguang, and Xuguang, offering flexible and reliable
solutions for our clients.

### **HOW TO CHOOSE A VCB**

Selecting a suitable Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB) requires careful evaluation of key technical
parameters, including **rated voltage, current, short-circuit breaking capacity**, and
**installation type**. Environmental conditions, insulation design, and mechanical endurance also
directly impact performance and service life. This guide outlines the essential criteria to help you
choose a VCB that fits your system requirements precisely.
1. **What are your voltage and current requirements?**
* Rated voltage: Available options include 12 kV, 24 kV, and 40.5 kV.
* Rated current: Match the breaker’s rated current with your system’s maximum continuous current.
  Available ratings include 630 A, 1250 A, 1600 A, 2000 A, 2500 A, 3150 A, etc.
* Short-circuit breaking capacity: Ensure the breaker’s interrupting capacity can safely break the
  maximum potential fault current in your system. Breaking capacity is available up to 50 kA.
2. **How do you intend to install the VCB?**
* Installation type: Choose between fixed type or withdrawable type, depending on your maintenance
  and application needs.
* Mounting options: Consider front-mounted or side-mounted designs. Side-mounted units offer
  specific top or right-side exhaust configurations, allowing precise integration with your
  switchgear layout.
* Pole spacing: Confirm the required pole pitch (e.g., 150 mm, 210 mm, 275 mm) to ensure physical
  compatibility with your existing switchgear. For customized dimensions, feel free to contact us
  for assistance.
3. **What are the environmental conditions and expected service life of the equipment?**
* Insulation method: Choose appropriate insulation materials based on the operating environment.
Embedded pole design is suitable for harsh conditions (e.g., dusty or humid environments).
Insulation sleeves are suitable for general-purpose environments.
* Operating requirements and service life: Evaluate key factors that affect long-term reliability,
  such as:
Required switching frequency; Expected mechanical endurance (some models support up to 10,000
operations, while the VSG series exceeds 15,000 operations); Environmental conditions the breaker
will face (e.g., temperature, altitude, pollution level).


### **OPERATING PRINCIPLE**

The operating principle of a Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB) is based on using a high-quality vacuum as
the arc extinction medium. The fixed and moving contacts are enclosed within a permanently sealed
vacuum interrupter. When the contacts separate, an arc forms due to the ionization of metal vapors.
However, in the high vacuum environment—typically maintained between 10⁻⁷ and 10⁻⁵ torr—these
metallic vapors, electrons, and ions rapidly condense onto the contact surfaces. This process
ensures swift arc extinction, rapid recovery of dielectric strength, and effective current
interruption. VCBs are widely used in medium voltage applications (11 kV to 33 kV) due to their
reliable arc quenching capability, minimal maintenance needs, and environmentally friendly
operation.

### **CONSTRUCTION**

A typical VCB is composed of fixed and moving contacts, an arc shield, and a vacuum interrupter
(VI), which serves as the sealed vacuum enclosure. The vacuum interrupter is hermetically sealed
using stainless steel bellows to ensure vacuum integrity over its entire service life. In
medium-voltage applications, the external insulating housing is usually made of glass or ceramic.
The arc shield plays a critical role in preserving internal insulation strength by preventing
metallic vapors from depositing on the inner surface of the outer insulation. The vacuum interrupter
itself consists of a steel arc chamber and symmetrically arranged ceramic insulators. The moving
contacts are actuated by flexible metallic bellows. Inside, the arc formed during contact separation
is effectively interrupted by a magnetic field generated by the spiral-shaped contacts, ensuring
reliable arc quenching and long-term operational performance.

(VI), which serves as the sealed vacuum enclosure. The vacuum interrupter is hermetically sealed
using stainless steel bellows to ensure vacuum integrity over its entire service life. In
medium-voltage applications, the external insulating housing is usually made of glass or ceramic.
The arc shield plays a critical role in preserving internal insulation strength by preventing
metallic vapors from depositing on the inner surface of the outer insulation. The vacuum interrupter
itself consists of a steel arc chamber and symmetrically arranged ceramic insulators. The moving
contacts are actuated by flexible metallic bellows. Inside, the arc formed during contact separation
is effectively interrupted by a magnetic field generated by the spiral-shaped contacts, ensuring
reliable arc quenching and long-term operational performance.

[Green Energy Electrical]

## [Outdoor switching Devices][75]

GEE’s **outdoor switching devices** are designed to deliver advanced technology, competitive
pricing, and dependable service for modern power distribution needs. Built to endure harsh
environmental conditions such as wind, rain, snow, dust, dew, ice, and frost, they are ideal for
open-air switchgear and control applications. Our product range includes **automatic circuit
reclosers, vacuum circuit breakers, load break switches, and disconnect switches**. Among them, the
**automatic circuit recloser** stands out as a versatile solution for overhead distribution lines
and substation applications, covering voltage classes from 11 kV to 38 kV in 50/60 Hz systems with
rated currents up to 1600 A. It integrates control, protection, measurement, communication, fault
detection, and real-time monitoring of open/close operations, fully compliant with **IEC 62271** and
**ANSI/IEEE C37.60** standards. This combination of robust design and multifunctional capability
ensures long-term reliability and operational efficiency in diverse outdoor environments.
